content: धूपः [धूप्-अच्] .²1 Incense, frankincense, perfume, any fragrant substance. .²2 The vapour issuing from any fragrant substance (like gum, resin <ab>&c.</ab>), aromatic vapour or smoke; धूपोष्मणा त्याजितमार्द्रभावम् <ls>Ku. 7. 14</ls>; <ls>Me. 34</ls>; <ls>V. 3. 2</ls>; <ls>R. 16. 50</ls>. .²3 A fragrant powder.
